name: local buckling
definition_zh: 构件局部板件在受力下失去稳定并出现局部变形的现象。
usage_note: 本文考虑钢管局部屈曲导致的钢材性能退化。
usage_overview: 在钢管混凝土构件数值分析中，关注钢管壁板局部失稳对钢材性能的影响；一类处理方式是在钢材本构中引入强度退化，以计入局部屈曲的影响。

complete_examples.text: However, the conventional fiber beam-column model could not be used to simulate the stress distribution of round-ended sections and the local buckling of steel plates.
During the compression phase, strength deterioration of steel due to local buckling may occur before the ultimate strength can be reached.
